title: philadelphus subcanus var. wilsonii
intro: Philadelphus subcanus var. wilsonii, commonly known as Wilson's Mock Orange, is a deciduous shrub in the Hydrangeaceae family. This plant is valued for its ornamental value, fragrant flowers, and medicinal properties. Wilson's Mock Orange has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
